title: gamble-core routine configuration
description: GENERATED from config/knobs.json by tools/gen_config.py. Field names are the environment variable names entrypoint.sh reads.

TASK.title: Workflow / Task
TASK.description: Which workflow to run. A default set here is NOT enough: the platform must pass the value into the container, as a command argument or in the environment. The run log names the source it arrived from.

PROFILE.title: Profile
PROFILE.description: A named settings file in config/profiles/. Individual fields below still override it. Recorded in the manifest, so a run is reproducible from its profile name.

NITER.title: Niter  [count, flat, nested, project]
NITER.description: Total MCMC sweeps.  Applies to: BMLEH_Los1_CAPRI_all, BMLEH_Los1_CAPRI_design, BMLEH_Los1_CAPRI_fit, BMLEH_Los1_CAPRI_more, BMLEH_Los1_CAPRI_smoke, GLOBIOM_subclass_all, GLOBIOM_subclass_design, GLOBIOM_subclass_fit, GLOBIOM_subclass_more, GLOBIOM_subclass_smoke, count, flat_design, flat_fit, nested.

NBURN.title: Nburn  [flat]
NBURN.description: Burn-in sweeps; must be < NITER. Empty keeps the driver default.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

THIN.title: Thin  [flat]
THIN.description: Store every k-th retained draw.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

N_CHAINS.title: N Chains  [count, flat, nested]
N_CHAINS.description: Chains fitted in parallel; Rhat needs at least 2.  Applies to: count, flat_design, flat_fit, nested.

SUBSAMPLE.title: Subsample  [nested]
SUBSAMPLE.description: 0 = every pixel; otherwise cap the pixel count.  Applies to: nested.

CLASSIFICATION.title: Classification [model spec]  [flat, nested]
CLASSIFICATION.description: Class column(s) the model predicts -- decides what the outcome IS.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit, nested.

RE_GROUP.title: Re Group [model spec]  [flat]
RE_GROUP.description: Grouping the random effects are keyed on.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

RE_VARS.title: Re Vars [model spec]  [flat]
RE_VARS.description: Covariates carrying a random effect. Empty = intercept only (the standard; measured to converge better than random slopes). 'all' = every linear covariate; or a comma-separated list.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

RE_BLOCK.title: Re Block [model spec]  [nested]
RE_BLOCK.description: Nested-path RE block. intercept is the documented standard.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: nested.

VARIANT.title: Variant [model spec]  [nested]
VARIANT.description: factorized = independent nests; iv = inclusive-value coupling.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: nested.

SYMMETRIC_HS.title: Symmetric Hs [model spec]  [nested]
SYMMETRIC_HS.description: Symmetric (zero-sum) horseshoe. TRUE is the standard; the job verifies the sampler carries the fix before fitting.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: nested.

USE_BART.title: Use Bart [model spec]  [flat]
USE_BART.description: Terrain (and whatever BART_COLS names) enters as a tree ensemble instead of linear terms. FLAT PATH ONLY -- nested_cut has no BART support.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

BART_COLS.title: Bart Cols [model spec]  [flat]
BART_COLS.description: 'topo' = the terrain block plus lon/lat when ADD_COORDS; '' = every non-focal column; or an explicit comma-separated list.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

NTREES_BART.title: Ntrees Bart [model spec]  [flat]
NTREES_BART.description: Trees per class in the ensemble.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

BART_K_PREV.title: Bart K Prev [model spec]  [flat]
BART_K_PREV.description: Prevalence-scaled leaf shrinkage. Measured super-additive with symmetric BART (+75.4 held-out together vs +38.4 symmetric alone); FALSE restores flat k.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

ADD_COORDS.title: Add Coords [model spec]  [flat]
ADD_COORDS.description: Add lon/lat as design columns. REQUIRED for BART_COLS=topo to cover coordinates -- without it 'topo' silently resolves to the 4 terrain columns.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

COORD_TYPE.title: Coord Type [model spec]  [flat]
COORD_TYPE.description: lonlat = EPSG:4326 degrees (readable); laea = native EPSG:3035 metres.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

MUNDLAK.title: Mundlak [model spec]  [flat]
MUNDLAK.description: Group-mean predictors for the RE prior mean. An interpretation fix (removes FE-RE correlation), not an accuracy one.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

PROMOTE_NATURAL_OTHER.title: Promote Natural Other [model spec]  [flat]
PROMOTE_NATURAL_OTHER.description: Move Natural_other out of the non-choosable residual.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: flat_design, flat_fit.

N_CORES.title: N Cores  [count, flat, nested]
N_CORES.description: Worker processes. Empty follows N_CHAINS; more cores than chains does not help.  Applies to: count, flat_design, flat_fit, nested.

M.title: M [model spec]  [nested]
M.description: Multiple-imputation draws of the inclusive value. Only reaches the model when VARIANT=iv; with factorized nests there is no inclusive value to impute.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable.  Applies to: nested.

BM_NITER.title: Bm Niter  [project]
BM_NITER.description: Sweeps for a project fit. Empty falls back to NITER, then to the project script's own 5000.  Applies to: BMLEH_Los1_CAPRI_all, BMLEH_Los1_CAPRI_design, BMLEH_Los1_CAPRI_fit, BMLEH_Los1_CAPRI_more, BMLEH_Los1_CAPRI_smoke, GLOBIOM_subclass_all, GLOBIOM_subclass_design, GLOBIOM_subclass_fit, GLOBIOM_subclass_more, GLOBIOM_subclass_smoke.

DESIGN_PATH.title: Design Path
DESIGN_PATH.description: Absolute path to a pixel_model_inputs*.rds. Set to remove all ambiguity; empty auto-detects on the drive and logs what it searched.

PROJECT.title: Project
PROJECT.description: Selects between staged design dumps for the generic tasks. Project tasks carry their own.

GAMBLE_WORK_DIR.title: Gamble Work Dir
GAMBLE_WORK_DIR.description: FUSE mount results are collected from; output/ and results/ are symlinked here.

GAMBLE_MASTER_PARQUET.title: Gamble Master Parquet
GAMBLE_MASTER_PARQUET.description: Covariate parquet for design builds. Auto-detected under /data when empty.

then.description: A design build reads the 1 km covariate parquet; without it there is nothing to assemble a design from. Auto-detected under /data when empty.
